business_summary: ERI Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides building confirmation and inspection, and housing performance evaluation services in Japan. The company also offers infrastructure/stock and environment related services; and other services. In addition, it provides services in the field of drone robotics transformation and construction related educations, as well as existing and under constructing buildings, including making of engineering report, legal compliance inspection, and home inspection; and periodic refresher courses. Further, the company is involved in measurement of co2 emission; forestation activities; purchase and sale of emission credit CDM applications; provision of consultation for energy saving; checking of designated building equipment; acts a forest civil engineering, hydrologic civil engineering, and civil engineering consultants; and development of building CAD and integration systems. ERI Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
